How the quiz picks gifts

  1. Start with them

    Pick up to two things they enjoy, from books and games to cooking and the outdoors.

  2. Set your budget

    Results stay inside your price range, with room for shipping and tax.

  3. Check before you buy

    Every suggestion lists the detail to confirm, such as size, edition, or gaming system.
